description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionSupervisorActor class, which manages child actors related to connection persistence within an Akka-based system. It handles actor creation, supervision strategies, and recovery behaviors for connection-related actors in the Ditto connectivity framework.

classes.name: ConnectionSupervisorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for supervising ConnectionPersistenceActor instances, managing their lifecycle, and handling restart strategies upon failure within the Ditto connectivity framework.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for instantiating a ConnectionSupervisorActor with specified parameters, setting up supervision strategies and context.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the ConnectionId entity associated with this supervisor actor based on its actor name.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Generates the Props needed to create a ConnectionPersistenceActor for a specific ConnectionId.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the back-off configuration used for restarting connection persistence actors after failure.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Defines shutdown behavior for the supervisor based on the connection ID, using pub-sub mediator and actor references.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Builds an exception indicating the connection is unavailable, used for propagating failure states.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the specified supervisor strategy that determines how child actor failures are handled.
